title: Лесенка: Up and Down
description: Наступай на ступеньки, подсвечивая слова. Лесенка 1 — свободное время (снизу-вверх), Лесенка 2 — вечер (сверху-вниз)

ladders.title: Свободное время (снизу вверх)
steps: I play computer games after school.
I play computer games after school in the afternoon.
I play computer games after school in the afternoon and listen to music.
I play computer games after school, listen to music and draw pictures.
I play computer games after school, listen to music, draw pictures and read comics.
I play computer games after school, listen to music, draw pictures, read comics and chat with my friends.
In my free time, I play computer games, listen to music, draw pictures, read comics and chat with my friends.

ladders.title: Вечер (сверху вниз)
steps: In the evening, I eat dinner, talk with my friends, play board games and watch a DVD before I go to bed.
In the evening, I eat dinner, talk with my friends, play board games and watch a DVD.
In the evening, I eat dinner, talk with my friends and play board games.
In the evening, I eat dinner and talk with my friends.
In the evening, I eat dinner and watch a DVD.
In the evening, I eat dinner and relax.
In the evening, I read comics and relax.
